title: 大自然的语言
pages_note: Read off the 目录 (教材 printed p. 3) and confirmed on each rendered page: 第十一课 runs pp. 115–124, 第十二课《探月》 starts p. 125. The 课文 is pp. 115–116; 生字 is at the foot of p. 116 and 词语/句子 on p. 117, so the three are split over two pages here where L03–L05 had them on one. 课堂练习 is pp. 118–121 (描一描写一写 and the first three rows of 读一读 118; the rest of 读一读, 用一用 and the top of 扩展与替换 119; the 替换 table, 想一想 and 对话 120; the end of the 对话 and 课堂游戏 121); the 阅读 text is pp. 122–123 with its 想一想 and 日积月累 on p. 124.

课文.text_note: Fully pinyin-annotated in the book. Not reproduced, by the same decision as L05: docs/chinese.md § 8 holds every 课文 back until the owner says where it may live.

生字.gloss_note: character and 拼音 are the book's; the gloss is authored here in both languages and is not printed in the book. The book prints eleven characters in two rows (8 + 3) and two radical tags beneath them: 虫——蚂 and 耂——考.

句型.ladder_note: The ladder card at the foot of p. 119 prints these three lines, the pattern itself as its first rung; the second rung has no full stop in the book.
句型.substitutions_note: The blue 替换 table at the top of p. 120: 只有 and 才能 are printed in red and stay; the three underlined parts (认真学习，细心观察 / 你 / 看得见，听得懂) are swapped row by row, as L04's table is kept. The table prints commas where the ladder and the 句子 have 、 — kept as the table prints them.

The margin prints ★ before each entry (空气 and 翅膀 on p. 122, 透气 and 脚步 on p. 123); each carries example phrases under it rather than a gloss, kept here in brackets as L04 keeps 帮忙 and 表示. p. 124 carries the reading's 想一想，说一说 (four questions) and 日积月累 (朝霞不出门，晚霞行千里。), neither reproduced.
